verdict.rationale: Data-residency or region selection is a fair question for an AI assistant and API platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents choosing where Gemini stores user data. The only region mentions concern where the service is available (AI Studio's 'available regions', the Canada availability comment), and the privacy items cover activity deletion, training opt-outs and export, none of which is a storage-location control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
